titre: Le marché mondial des médicaments de l'obésité
sous_titre: Ventes mondiales en prix catalogue, en Mds $, de 2020 à 2026

series.nom: Ventes mondiales de médicaments de l'obésité

2020.texte: In 2020, global spending on anti-obesity medications (AOMs) stood at approximately US$3 billion.

2024.texte: By 2024, that figure had soared to US$30+ billion, a more than tenfold increase in just four years.

2025.texte: The global Obesity Medicines market reached $66 billion in list price sales value in 2025, according to IQVIA's ForecastLink

2026 (prévision).texte: is forecast to rise to $92 billion in 2026, before reaching between $105 billion and $200 billion by 2027 and beyond
